adding mango butter in your regular dry skin care routine

It is a natural humectant. In simpler words
it is a magnet for moisture. This means that Glycerin pulls moisture into the skin. Hence
regular use of Glycerin helps to enhance and restore skin’s moisture content. This results in a visibly hydrated
glowing skin. Therefore we may rightfully label Glycerin as a true life-saver for dry skin. Glycerin is also known to be non-comedogenic and non-toxic. In addition
it is a veritable penetration-enhancer that helps other ingredients to penetrate deeper into the skin.

ingredients_raw: Brows That Look Done — Without Looking Drawn On
Getting natural-looking brows is genuinely harder than it seems. Go too light and they disappear; go too heavy and they look like they're painted on. The

solves this with an ultra-fine tip that deposits pigment exactly where you place it — individual stroke by stroke — so you can fill gaps and define your arch without that telltale "brow pencil" look. If you've avoided brow products because everything you've tried looks fake
this is the one to try first.
How the Ultra-Fine Tip Changes Everything

Most brow pencils have a tip that's too thick to mimic real hair — so strokes end up looking like smudged blocks rather than individual brows. The Arch Arrival's micro-precision tip is thin enough to draw hair-like strokes that blend in with your natural brow hairs
especially useful if you have sparse patches or uneven growth. The formula is pigmented but not waxy
so it doesn't crumble or tug on skin
and it has a slightly powdery finish that reads as natural rather than sharp or shiny.
The brow definer gives you defined

well-groomed brows that last 6–8 hours without significant fading or smudging in normal conditions. Humid climates and very oily skin may cause some softening of the lines by hour 5–6 — setting with a clear brow gel extends wear significantly. The spoolie brush on the other end is essential: always brush through after drawing your strokes to blend and soften the result. Skipping this step is what makes brows look too sharp or unnatural.
How to Fill Brows Like a Pro
Use a feather-light pressure and short strokes in the direction of hair growth — it's much easier to add more than to remove excess.
Concentrate the most product from your arch to the tail
where natural brows tend to be thinnest
and use an even lighter hand on the inner third.
blend with the spoolie to soften lines and ensure the product integrates with your actual brow hairs.
A clear brow gel over the top keeps everything in place and adds a groomed
polished finish without adding extra colour.
Shade Matching for Indian Skin Tones

Most brow pencils have a tip that's too thick to mimic real hair — so strokes end up looking like smudged blocks rather than individual brows. The Arch Arrival's micro-precision tip is thin enough to draw hair-like strokes that blend in with your natural brow hairs

ingredients_raw: Colorbar Vita Hemp Restoring & Balancing Anti-Acne/Spot Gel
Colorbar Vita Hemp Anti Acne Spot Gel
is a carefully crafted multi-action pH balanced gel

enriched with a blend of powerful ingredients which target to fight & prevent active acne to keep your skin hydrated & blemish free! Salicylic Acid (Active from Germany) has the ability to penetrate deep into pores
exfoliate & dissolve clogged substances which can lead to acne while Glycolic Acid gently exfoliates the top layer to remove dead skin cells
reduce blemishes & reveal a smoother skin with fewer irregularities. Niacinamide (Active from Switzerland) helps regulate sebum production

minimizes appearance of enlarged pores while reducing appearance of blemishes & fighting pigmentation. Zinc PCA (Active from Japan) further helps to mitigate unwanted sebum delivering a fresh matte look to your skin. Vitamin C (Active from Switzerland) helps fight dark spots and promotes even skin tone! Willow bark Extract (Active from Japan) along with Tea tree oil with their anti bacterial properties help prevent future acne to surface on the skin. Hyaluronic Acid and Pentavitin (Active from Switzerland) keep the skin hydrated.
A return & exchange policy crafted with your satisfaction in mind.

High Coverage Concealer - Full Coverage Liquid Formula for Flawless Skin
ingredients_raw: How to Apply High Cover Concealer
moisturized skin. Apply your regular skincare products and allow them to absorb fully before using this high coverage concealer.
Select a face concealer shade that's one to two shades lighter than your foundation for under-eye brightening
or match your skin tone exactly for covering blemishes and imperfections.
apply the high coverage liquid concealer to areas needing coverage:
Under eyes in an inverted triangle shape
On eyelids and lips as a primer

blend using gentle patting or dabbing motions rather than rubbing. Work in small strokes to seamlessly blend the edges into your skin. A damp beauty sponge works particularly well for achieving a natural finish.
This concealer with high coverage is buildable. If you need additional coverage
allow the first layer to set for 30 seconds
then apply a second thin layer and blend.
To ensure your high coverage concealer lasts all day without creasing
lightly dust translucent powder over concealed areas using a fluffy brush. Gently tap off excess powder to avoid a cakey appearance.
Apply concealer AFTER foundation for most situations
Use less product than you think you need
Warm the product on the back of your hand before applying for easier blending
avoid tugging or pulling at delicate skin
